scripts.setup: yarn install --frozen-lockfile && yarn --cwd server install --frozen-lockfile && yarn --cwd client install --frozen-lockfile && yarn --cwd server ensure-cache && yarn --cwd server build-collision
scripts.start: yarn concurrently --kill-others --names server,client "yarn --cwd server start" "yarn --cwd client start"
scripts.server: yarn --cwd server ensure-cache && yarn concurrently --kill-others --names world-1,world-2 "yarn --cwd server start:world --world=1" "yarn --cwd server start:world --world=2"
